94c1f2712d.q: Why does Sheridan Capital Partners avoid investing in drug development and medical device companies despite AI opportunities in advancing science?
94c1f2712d.a: Jonathan Lewis explains that Sheridan prefers derivative strategies to avoid the binary risk inherent in drug development and medical devices—where some firms make 50X returns but experience zeros along the way. Instead, Sheridan targets doubles and triples consistently, which aligns with investor expectations.
